services.desc: Kayaking Tour and Shelter Cove Fireworks Display! 2.5 Hours Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your scheduled tour time On Tuesday evenings in the summer months our regular 2 hour evening sunset tour is followed by the Shelter Cove fireworks show. Just like all of our other tours we kayak through the beautiful salt marsh of Broad Creek where we search for dolphins. We also explore the marsh channels where the occasional mink or otter might surprise us and where many of the beautiful wading birds come to feed. quotes.text: What a wonderful outing! This was my first time Kayaking, so I was a bit nervous. Alton was our guide, and he made me feel relaxed, comfortable, and at home straight away. Our group of 10 had a wonderful two hour tour on our kayaks in the ocean…

Alton was a great guide. Very funny and laid back. He also provided great local information about the animal and plant life. I recommend Kayak Hilton Head to anyone wanting to spend some time on the water and enjoy the local wildlife.

We had a huge group, 19 people…with our two guides Alton and Jake, we had a total blast. We saw egrets, heron, and a pod of dolphins. Sunshine, stories of Broad Creek, and a lot of laughter made for a wonderful 2-hour adventure.

We took a 2 hour guided kayak tour with our guide Zach. We also saw a dolphin and followed it for about 10 minutes as it bobbed in and out of the water. Definitely recommend to anyone who wants to see wildlife up close.

We loved our kayaking experience with Kayak Hilton Head! We saw dolphins, all kinds of birds, and lots of crabs and snails. Our boys (8 & 10) thought it was really fun and loved all the wildlife. I’d highly recommend!

We had a great time on our kayak tour. We went in the morning, and did get to see a couple of dolphins as well as many birds. We also enjoyed our tour guide- he provided lots of neat facts about the island…
